description: The agent must: (1) Read project_brief.txt to understand the migration scenario. (2) Recognize this is a complex, long-running, multi-team migration (many databases, external BigQuery dependency, DBA sub-team, 48h duration) and classify it as a HEAVYWEIGHT plan per SKILL.md rules. (3) Produce migration_plan.md with all 5 required plan shape sections: Goal, Constraints, Ordered Steps, Verification Points, and Possible Blockers. (4) Write each numbered step answering all three sub-questions: what to do, what tool/file it touches, and what counts as success. (5) Include a Reporting section with all 4 fields: planned scope, what completed, what changed during execution, and what remains. (6) Ground the plan in the actual scenario details (Aurora, the three db names, BigQuery pipeline, FK constraint issue, DNS cutover, zero-downtime constraint, IAM auth blocker). The key proprietary traps: generic agents will write a prose plan without the 5-section shape, skip per-step sub-questions entirely, omit the reporting summary, and fail to explicitly acknowledge the heavyweight classification.
